test_case.purpose: Sustain the approved FurMark workload for one continuous hour with verified 2560x1440 render and physical output, while independently validating GPU health, high-resolution display-link stability, ECC/events and visible pixels.
required_package: Approved FurMark 1.29.0.0 artifact/source/license/hash and exact burn-in preset, AA, fullscreen/window and 2560x1440 render settings
Exact Windows/GPU/driver/VBIOS/OpenGL identity plus requested/active/negotiated 2560x1440 refresh, scaling, color and link data
Approved continuous 60-minute duration, sampling cadence, comparable score/stability threshold and invalid-result rule
ECC baseline/delta/severity and GPU core/hotspot/memory thermal, power, clock/throttle, driver and link abort thresholds
Dedicated cooled window, bounded evidence storage, qualified physical operator and independent recovery/cooldown
test_case.test_command: REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; after approved bindings and execution OK, verify artifact hash, exact GPU/display identity, positive OpenGL support, separate 2560x1440 render/active/negotiated modes, baseline ECC/events and safe headroom without clearing logs. Launch only the approved FurMark preset for 60 continuous minutes, sample GPU/link/platform state at the approved cadence and retain complete result plus time-correlated physical display evidence. An interruption invalidates coverage and is not auto-retried. Collect final ECC/event deltas and health and stop at any abort limit.
test_case.expected_result: Approved preset runs uninterrupted for at least 60 minutes with internal render, active desktop and negotiated physical output all at 2560x1440; result meets the approved threshold, no hang/reset/disallowed throttle occurs, thermal/power/link and ECC/event values remain within limits, and physical output has no corruption, flicker, tearing, freeze, scaling/crop/color or edge artifact.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the complete one-hour run and every 1440p layer, score/stability, health, ECC/event and visual threshold. A 20-minute run cannot PASS. FAIL on interruption, wrong render/link mode, invalid result, artifact/hang, thermal/power/throttle/link/driver limit or unacceptable ECC/event delta. BLOCKED at runtime when required configuration is absent. End user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Do not install unapproved artifacts or run on production; require dedicated cooling/power and independent recovery.
Do not infer internal render from desktop mode or physical link from screenshots; capture all three layers.
Preserve complete existing SEL/Windows/GPU evidence and use baseline/delta rather than one grep.
Stop on first approved limit and do not retry, reset or reboot automatically; record cooldown/final health.
expected_evidence: Exact GPU/driver/OpenGL/display identity plus render/active/negotiated 2560x1440 proof
Timestamped uninterrupted runtime and full FurMark result/validity/score
Thermal/power/clock/throttle/link timeline and complete ECC/SEL/Windows baseline-delta
1440p-specific physical visual record, no-cross-resolution-reuse audit, recovery/cooldown and verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop FurMark at the first failure, preserve all 1440p evidence and do not retry. Use only approved Windows recovery, cool down, verify GPU/driver/display/BMC health and restore the approved session without automatic reset/reboot.
